item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 21/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring very hot weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of southern China on Saturday. There will be a few showers over the region during the weekend. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier and temperatures will fall slightly over the coast of Guangdong early next week.
